name: Beginner Big Cubes Ohio 2026
information:
### *Please note that this competition takes place at a different venue than the previous Beginner Big Cubes Ohio competitions.*

This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for first-time competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio.
This competition also takes place on a **Friday Evening**. Please plan accordingly!

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.

All competitiors will be expected to help during the group they are not competing in.
